codes.title: Tuberculosis of lung
evidence_quotes: kikohozi x3 wks, not improving on amoxil.
night sweats, wt loss 2kg (mother says clothes loose).
father had 'chest problem' treated 6 months in 2024
sputum sent for genexpert - result awaited.
codes.reasoning: The patient presented with classic symptoms of pulmonary TB (cough over 2 weeks, hemoptysis, night sweats, weight loss, and close contact exposure) per GDL-019. Because GeneXpert sputum results are pending and anti-TB treatment has not yet been initiated, 1C12 is assigned with a suspected/pending status rather than the bacteriologically confirmed code 1C12.1.
